The '''thinsuit''', sometimes known as '''[[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]] thinsuit''' or '''Karflo's Thinsuit''', was a light body armor skintight undergarment that protected users against hostile environments including [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]], chemicals, pressure, temperature and vacuum, although it did not provide [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]]. Unless heavily modified, it was ineffective against direct attacks such as [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts, but a thinsuit was so thin than a user could don a second armor or clothes over it.

Through the years, thinsuits were used by professional [[Scout/Legends|scouts]]; by the [[Cularin Militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]; and by the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], particularly [[Wilderness Fighters]] and the elite teams expert in fighting aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]].

==Description==
The thinsuit was a one-[[Kilogram/Legends|kilogram]] outfit made of a very isolating, very thin material.<ref name="AE" /> It conformed tightly to the body of the wearer, being so snug that the wearer could don a second armor or clothes over the thinsuit.<ref name="AECW">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'', ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The thinsuit covered&mdash;and protected&mdash;all of the wearer's body<ref name="ROAECW">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> except for the face.<ref name="ROCW">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> However, the thinsuit was provided with a face-covering [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]] featuring an [[extended filter]]<ref name="ROAEGGCW">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'' and ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> that purified external atmosphere for six hours<ref name="ROGG">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]''</ref> or provided one hour of internal air before running out.<ref name="AECW" /> The suit also had easily-reachable<ref name="GG" /> storage pockets<ref name="RO" /> containing five more filters.<ref name="ROGG" />

The thinsuit was designed to protect the wearer from hostile environments. While it was useless against direct attacks such as [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolts,<ref name="GG" /> it provided isolation against limited exposure to [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]]<ref name="RO" /> or to hostile chemicals in the atmosphere<ref name="ROGG" /> withstanding up to eighteen hours against most kinds of hostile atmosphere.<ref name="GG" /> It also protected against extreme pressure<ref name="AECW" /> and temperatures<ref name="ROAECW" /> from -30 to 100 [[Standard (temperature)|standard degrees]].<ref name="RO" /> The thinsuit included an environmental system<ref name="CW">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> of small heaters and coolers that kept the wearer comfortable in these situations.<ref name="AECW" />

The thinsuit endured puncturing, tearing<ref name="ROGG" /> and slashing.<ref name="GG" /> As it was also isolated against vacuum,<ref name="RO" /> it could be used as an emergency space suit.<ref name="ROGG" /> In that case, it provided heat and protection to the wearer for one hour, but it did not provide a means for the wearer to breathe.<ref name="GG" />

==History==
[[File:StornThinsuit.png|thumb|left|100px|Thinsuit]]
The thinsuit, developed by [[Karflo Corporation/Legends|Karflo Corporation]],<ref name="ROAECW" /> was available for 900 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the last years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="AE" /> The suit was alternatively known as Karflo Corporation Thinsuit,<ref name="ROAE">''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'', ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> Karflo's thinsuit<ref name="RO" /> or simply thinsuit.<ref name="GGCW">''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'', ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic-aligned [[Cularin Militia]] stored several thinsuits among its arsenal of military gear, in preparation for an open conflict against its neighbor, the [[Thaereian system]], which had joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], the [[heroes of Cularin]] helped the Militia in a mission in the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]]. In gratitude, the Militia offered the heroes some of their thinsuits, or any other item in their depot.<ref name="DA">{{LivingForce|Decision: Almas}}</ref>

During the later [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], thinsuits were worn by professional [[Scout/Legends|scouts]], as these items were useful in their activities.<ref name="GG" /> The [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], elite [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], also used thinsuits. Members of its [[Marines (SpecForce)|1st Regiment]], experts in fighting aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]], found the armor very useful. Its 4th Regiment, the [[Wilderness Fighters]], also enjoyed the isolation provided by the thinsuits.<ref name="RO" />

Thinsuits were available after the Galactic Civil War, during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="AE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The thinsuit was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts]]'' ([[1993]]), a supplement to [[West End Games]]'s [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]] written by [[Bill Olmesdahl]] and [[Bill Smith]]. The thinsuit was first depicted in an image by [[Storn Cook]] for ''[[Rules of Engagement: The Rebel SpecForce Handbook]]'' ([[1997]]).
